Feel the rhythm of 90s Bollywood romance with “Dhak Dhak Dil Mera Karne Laga”, a popular song from the film Aadmi (1993). Featuring Mithun Chakraborty and Gautami, this energetic romantic track is beautifully sung by Kumar Sanu and Kavita Krishnamurthy.

Song: Dhak Dhak Dil Mera Karne Laga
Movie: Aadmi (1993)
Star Cast: Mithun Chakraborty & Gautami
Singer: Kumar Sanu & Kavita Krishnamurthy
Music Director: Jatin Lalit
Lyricist: Anwar Sagar
